entries.text: Gardiner’s first B-minor Mass is mid-1980s Archiv HIP with a mixed choir of roughly two dozen and concertino–ripieno contrasts inside the Monteverdi Choir — not one-voice-per-part. Choral vitality and continuo practice still make the case. Gardiner later remade it because he judged this set incomplete; the remake does not retire the benchmark status the 1985 tapes acquired. Référence for the mid-1980s Archiv HIP studio Mass.
